split_policy.primary_axis: dispatch-reopen guardrail behavior before fixture directory label, markdown heading label, issue number label, agent id label, command string, source path label, generated row, report row, old-mode label, gate label, retired route label, compatibility label, or migration label
split_policy.positive_rule: dispatch-reopen positives are limited to the hand-authored happy fixture where lane ownership, intake order, dispatch closeout order, runner preflight chain, freshness/provenance evidence, hard/soft gates, and Lane B validation are all canonical and strict
split_policy.canonical_rejection_rule: W2 drift rows, missing lane validation rows, invalid UTF-8 rows, stale order rows, missing freshness/provenance rows, generated-only rows, evidence-log rows, migration-only rows, old-mode rows, gate rows, retired route rows, and compatibility rows are non-positive rejection or provenance evidence
split_policy.strict_error_rule: invalid UTF-8 fixture bytes, missing Lane B pytest validation, reordered merge or closeout sequence, missing AR-DEP-M03-02 freshness linkage, missing AR-FRESHNESS-01, reordered hard-gate sequence, and drifted hard/soft matrix ordering own fail-closed strict-error evidence
split_policy.provenance_rule: markdown fixture files, batch ids, issue numbers, agent ids, lane labels, command strings, source-of-truth input paths, evidence ids, gate ids, dependency ids, commit ids, and owner-split routing rows remain provenance unless e2e/tooling or rejection owners claim the behavior boundary
split_policy.retired_surface_rule: old-mode dispatch reopen, gate dispatch reopen, retired route dispatch reopen, compatibility dispatch reopen, migration-only rows, generated-only rows, evidence-log rows, runner-only success, workflow-label-only success, invalid-encoding positives, stale-order positives, missing-validation positives, drift positives, and generated/report rows promoted as support are canonical rejection, strict-error, absent-support, or provenance-only evidence
